title: Hayati Pro Max Lemon Peach Passionfruit Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Lemon Peach Passionfruit is a vibrant medley of sweet, sharp, and exotic fruit notes. Juicy Peach lays down a rich, velvety base, while Lemon adds a zesty kick. The Passionfruit brings a tropical tang that ties the whole blend together with an exotic, fruity intensity. Made with nicotine salts for quick absorption and a smoother inhale, this e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits and vape pens. The 50VG/50PG formulation provides balanced vapour production and reliably full flavour. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
